report.source_notes: Imports & weight: UN Comtrade (Jordan=400, partner World, flow M, CIF USD), pulled 2026-10-09. Customs: WITS/TRAINS MFN simple average 2023. Reefer freight USD 4,500/40ft (no published lane rate found); payload 21,500 kg = midpoint of 18-25 t per 40ft reefer (supplier listing freshdi.com/product/Straight-Cut-Frozen-French-Fries). shipping_pct = (freight/payload)/import_price_per_kg_usd; CIF price already includes freight - do not add on top. Raw material: Ministry of Agriculture bulletin, Amman Central Market, 29 Mar 2026: potatoes 25/35/50 piasters per kg (min/most common/max); used 35 piasters = 0.35 JOD/kg. Yield: 1.5-1.6 kg raw potatoes per kg frozen fries at factory gate (indianpotato.com/how-many-potatoes-for-1-kg-french-fries). Conversion cost (labour, energy, overheads) is an estimate. Raw-material availability evidence: Jordan grows and exports potatoes (WITS 070190 exports 2023: 3,992 t); seed potatoes imported (>JD 7M/yr, Al Mamlaka 2026). Machinery cost: see machine_source. FX: 1 JOD = 1.4104 USD (CBJ peg 0.709).
report.machine_source: Made-in-China supplier listings, Oct 2026: Frozen fries line USD 45,000-150,000 (wellymachinery) to semi-automatic 100-300 kg/h line USD 390,000-420,000 (zhuchengtianshun)

explanation.summary: Frozen French fries scored 8.6 out of 10, so local manufacturing looks worth exploring. Indicative break-even: selling about 1,458 tonnes (1.8% of 2024 imports) at the import-parity price would pay back about 232,500 USD of equipment (equipment only; excludes buildings and working capital).
reasons_for: Competition is limited: 0 local factories against a saturation level of 3.
Imports are sizeable: about 92.8 million USD in 2024, changing by 19.4% per year.
Imports cost about 1.3 USD/kg including customs (freight is already in the import price), against an estimated local cost of 1.14 USD/kg.
concerns: أعلى كلفة مكنة بين الفئات؛ سلسلة تبريد وترخيص من مؤسسة الغذاء والدواء؛ سعر البطاطا موسمي؛ مذكرة تفاهم 2024 (وفرة × الضامن للاستثمار) لمصنع كبير ممكن يدخل السوق

High capital requirement: the equipment alone is listed at 45,000 to 420,000 USD, and this is only part of the investment (ex-works supplier listing prices, excluding shipping, customs, installation, moulds and buildings).
Cost figures are estimates and must be checked against real supplier quotes.
next_steps: Get written quotes from machinery and raw-material suppliers.
Talk to local wholesalers and retailers to confirm demand and target prices.
Check licensing, standards and incentives with the Jordan Investment Commission and the Chamber of Industry.
caveats: The figures for these items are estimates, not measured values: local production cost, conversion_cost_per_kg_usd, machinery availability, skills availability, number of local factories, market saturation level, shipping cost, protection_pct.
This is a quick screening estimate, not a business plan or financial advice.
